study_title: ANJANEY: Campus Mental-Health Screening Aid Gating Test

hypotheses.rq1: Within-session check-in drift differs significantly between high-risk (PHQ-8 >= 10) and low-risk participants after position conditioning.
hypotheses.rq3: Adding personal-baseline deviation signals improves selective risk and conformal interval efficiency over population-only fusion.

decision_rules.supported: Permutation p < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 AND |Cohen's d| >= 0.30
decision_rules.falsified: Bootstrap 95% CI includes 0 (drift is generic task fatigue)
decision_rules.inconclusive: Permutation p < 0.05 but effect size |d| < 0.30 or CI marginally touches 0
